Your blood pressure was 168/98. It was measured at the surgery on 25 September 2026.

- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

- What will happen at my nurse appointment?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

judgement.reason: The output passes all three criteria. 1) No lifestyle or diet advice: there is nothing about salt, exercise, weight, alcohol or stress. 2) It doesn't call the reading dangerous and doesn't say it's nothing to worry about. It gives 168/98 as written and suggests the patient ask the doctor what it means. 3) It keeps the instruction to use the waiting-room machine once a week for 4 weeks and give the readings to reception. It also keeps the Thursday 29 October 2026 09:30 nurse appointment. The question 'What should I do with my readings each week?' is only a question for the doctor, not new advice. It is a bit redundant, since the letter already says to give the readings to reception. The line 'The letter does not list specific warning signs' is accurate.
